evidence: The paper mentions random forest only in future work: "a full evaluation and validation of the potential of plastome tracing requires conducting (self-) assignment tests, e.g., using random forest analyses [ 49 , 50 ] or a Nearest Neighbour Approach [ 51 ]" (Next steps section). The actual methods employed are RAxML phylogenetic trees, DAPC, haplotype networks, Mantel correlation tests, and PCA - none involving impurity importance. Random forest is not used in the current study.
